scope: Read-only assessment of direction C, current-kernel feasibility, bounded same-state diagnostic design, and conditional interface with A+B. No implementation, label generation, training, ANN execution, validation access, or held-out access.

external_primary_sources.title: Query-Driven Iterated Neighborhood Graph Search for Large Scale Indexing
external_primary_sources.use: Strongest mechanism collision: query/search-history-driven remote pivots are injected while the same candidate queue, result set, and visit/color history continue. It does not learn candidate-specific continue-versus-intervene values or provide paired branches under one preregistered residual cap with per-branch actual-cost accounting.

external_primary_sources.title: ANNiE: A Learned Query Cost Estimator for Graph-Based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
external_primary_sources.authors: Zeyu Wang; Manos Chatzakis; Qitong Wang; Themis Palpanas; Peng Wang; Wei Wang
external_primary_sources.use: Closest modern learned one-shot live-state continuation control: ANNiE-S detects a search phase transition, predicts total query cost, and continues the retained search state, but does not choose or force-expand a remote entry.

external_primary_sources.title: Improving Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search through Learned Adaptive Early Termination
external_primary_sources.authors: Conglong Li; Minjia Zhang; David G. Andersen; Yuxiong He
external_primary_sources.use: Learned checkpoint features and resume-from-current-search ancestor; its action is residual budget prediction rather than remote-entry intervention.

external_primary_sources.title: DARTH: Declarative Recall Through Early Termination for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search

external_primary_sources.year_venue: 2026; Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data

external_primary_sources.title: Distribution-Aware Exploration for Adaptive HNSW Search
external_primary_sources.year_venue: 2026; Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data

external_primary_sources.use: Two-probe answer-set-flux hardness estimator and per-query beam predictor; the published probes are independent rather than retained-state remote intervention.

limitations: The external search was targeted rather than exhaustive; no first-of-kind claim is established.
QING removes any broad claim of first mid-search pivot injection or first retained-state restart; ANNiE and early-termination work remove broad learned live-state-control claims.
The proposed narrow contribution is only a conditional research candidate until a same-state finite-action oracle and state-versus-query-only learnability gate pass.
No external author repository was executed, and no baseline was reproduced in this assessment.
All C0-C4 thresholds and procedures are design proposals, not approved protocols or observed results.
The worktree was already dirty; unrelated source, artifacts, logs, indexes, and results were not modified or cleaned.
